cards.name: Exotic Pets
cards.oracleText: Create two 1/1 blue Fish creature tokens with "This token can't be blocked." Then for each kind of counter among creatures you control, put a counter of that kind on either of those tokens.

cards.name: Exotic Disease
cards.oracleText: Domain — Target player loses X life and you gain X life, where X is the number of basic land types among lands you control.

cards.name: Exotic Orchard
cards.oracleText: {T}: Add one mana of any color that a land an opponent controls could produce.
